beedell.roke:

I invoke it via

So the screenshot you show at the bottom has in the upper right the kernel you are using as ‘Python 3.15.2’, I think. (I only ever use actual Jupyter that show ipkernel so I am guessing a bit there, but what I see for the errors is consistent.)
However, that code in the cell isn’t Python. So it won’t work and is saying SyntaxError: invalid decimal literal, etc.. From the text of what you provided as your notebook in the code block at the tiop, from the medata it looks like you’d want "languageId": "powershell". I don’t know if that is a common kernel. I have used the Bash kernel. And more often than not, it is easier to run bash commands in ipykernel notebooks with the %%bash cell magic (see here) or subprocess. I don’t use powershell at all so I cannot tell you if there is an equivalent. I think you can to some extent because of the answer to Executing Windows PowerShell commands in a Jupyter Notebook.

See also:

  • PowerShell in Jupyter Notebook - #2 by krassowski
  • Executing Windows PowerShell commands in a Jupyter Notebook

    "%%script powershell-preview -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command \"& ([scriptblock]::Create([Console]::In.ReadToEnd()))\"\n",
    "#!/usr/bin/env -S powershell-preview -File\n",
    "$Package = \"com.android.settings\"\n",
    "$DumpSys = adb shell \"dumpsys package $Package\"\n",
    "$Object = [Ordered]@{}\n",
    "@{\n",
    "\tversionCode = 'versionCode=(\\d+)'\n",
    "\tversionName = 'versionName=([^\\s]+)'\n",
    "}.GetEnumerator() | ForEach-Object {\n",
    "\t$Match = [RegEx]::Match(\n",
    "\t\t$DumpSys,\n",
    "\t\t$_.Value,\n",
    "\t\t[System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::Multiline\n",
    "\t)\n",
    "\tIf ($Match.Success) {\n",
    "\t\t$Value = $Match.Groups[1].Value\n",
    "\t\t$Int64 = 0L\n",
    "\t\t$Object[$_.Key] =\n",
    "\t\t\tIf ([Long]::TryParse($Value, [Ref]$Int64)) {\n",
    "\t\t\t\t$Int64\n",
    "\t\t\t} Else {\n",
    "\t\t\t\t$Value\n",
    "\t\t\t}\n",
    "\t}\n",
    "}\n",
    "$Object.installer = (\n",
    "\tadb shell 'pm list packages -i' |\n",
    "\t\tSelect-String \"^package:$([RegEx]::Escape($Package)) \" |\n",
    "\t\tForEach-Object {\n",
    "\t\t\t$_ -replace '^.*installer='\n",
    "\t\t}\n",
    ")\n",
    "$Object |\n",
    "\tConvertTo-JSON -Compress |\n",
    "\tyq -P\n"
   ]
